units.source_text: 内大臣一路上想道：“让他们结婚，也并不是一件十分乖异的坏事。

en.t: On the way, the Minister of the Interior thought, "Letting them marry would not, after all, be such a very perverse or wicked thing.

units.source_text: 然而姑表姐弟成亲，这因缘太平凡了。

en.t: But for cousins on the mother's side to marry is far too ordinary a match.

units.source_text: 外人也要议论。

en.t: Outsiders would gossip about it too.

units.source_text: 况且源氏强把我女儿弘徽殿女御压倒，

en.t: Besides, Genji has forcibly overshadowed my daughter, the Kokiden Consort,

units.source_text: 我很气愤，正指望这云居雁入宫伺候太子，

en.t: and I am deeply angry; I was counting on Kumoinokari entering the palace to serve the Crown Prince,

units.source_text: 也许能压倒他人，为我争这口气呢。

en.t: so that perhaps she might outshine the others and win back my pride for me.

units.source_text: 真可恨啊！”

en.t: How hateful this is!"

units.source_text: 源氏和这内大臣的交情，自昔至今，大体上很和睦。

en.t: Genji and this Minister of the Interior had, from former days until now, generally been on friendly terms.

units.source_text: 但在权势方面，两人一向有争执。

en.t: But in matters of power and influence, the two had always been rivals.

units.source_text: 内大臣回想过去吃的亏，不免心中气愤。

en.t: When the Minister of the Interior recalled the losses he had suffered in the past, he could not help feeling angry.

units.source_text: 因此这天晚上不能安枕，直到天明。

en.t: Because of this, he could not sleep peacefully that night and lay awake until dawn.

units.source_text: 他推想太君一定知道两人之事，

en.t: He supposed that the lady must certainly know about the two of them,

units.source_text: 但因过分溺爱这孙女与外孙，故一切听其所为。

en.t: but because she doted too much on this granddaughter and grandson, she let them do as they pleased.

units.source_text: 回想起那两个侍女的议论，

en.t: When he thought back on the talk of those two serving women,

units.source_text: 觉得实在可恶可恨，弄得他心绪不宁。

en.t: he found it truly detestable and hateful, and it left his mind unsettled.

units.source_text: 这个人性情有些刚强，行为每多锋芒，

en.t: This man had a somewhat forceful temperament, and his conduct often had sharp edges,

units.source_text: 因此有了心事，不能自制。

en.t: so once something troubled him, he could not restrain himself.

units.source_text: 过了两天之后，他又前去参谒太君。

en.t: After two days had passed, he went again to pay his respects to the lady.

units.source_text: 太君看见这儿子常来请安，

en.t: Seeing that this son often came to greet her and ask after her health,

units.source_text: 觉得甚可嘉许，心中非常高兴。

en.t: the lady thought it very commendable and was extremely pleased at heart.

units.source_text: 她的头发像尼姑一般剪短，身穿一件崭新的礼服。

en.t: Her hair was cut short like a nun's, and she wore a brand-new ceremonial robe.

units.source_text: 虽然是儿子，但终是一位内大臣，也得客气些，

en.t: Although he was her son, he was after all a Minister of the Interior, so some formality was required,

units.source_text: 因此太君坐在帷屏里面接待他。

en.t: and therefore the lady received him while seated behind a curtain screen.

units.source_text: 内大臣心情不快，对母亲说：“儿子今天来此参谒，心中很不自在。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior, in low spirits, said to his mother, "I have come here today to pay my respects, but my heart is very uneasy.

units.source_text: 想到这里的侍女们多么看不起我，甚是畏缩。

en.t: When I think how much the serving women here look down on me, I feel deeply cowed.

units.source_text: 儿子虽然不肖，但只要生在这世上，

en.t: Although your son is unworthy, so long as I live in this world,

units.source_text: 始终不离母亲左右，决不违背尊意。

en.t: I will always remain by Mother's side and never go against your wishes.

units.source_text: 然而为了这个不良的小女为非作歹，

en.t: Yet because this wicked little daughter has behaved so badly,

units.source_text: 致使我不得不怨恨母亲。

en.t: I have been brought to the point where I cannot help resenting Mother.

units.source_text: 本来不须如此怨恨，然而终于忍耐不住。”

en.t: I ought not to bear such resentment, but at last I can no longer endure it."

units.source_text: 说着，举手拭泪。

en.t: As he spoke, he raised his hand and wiped away his tears.

units.source_text: 太君吃了一惊，那化妆得很漂亮的脸忽然变色，

en.t: The lady was startled, and her beautifully made-up face suddenly changed color,

units.source_text: 眼睛也睁大了，问道：“究竟为了何事，

en.t: her eyes widening as she asked, "For what reason, after all,

units.source_text: 我活到这么大年纪，还要受你怨恨？”

en.t: must I, having lived to such an old age, still be subjected to your resentment?"
